meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 将应用部署到 Vercel 并管理项目配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将前端应用部署到 Vercel 平台
copy.tagline_en: Deploy apps to Vercel and manage project settings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently deploy frontend apps to Vercel

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能用 Vercel 的命令行工具部署 Web 应用到生产或预览环境，管理项目、域名和环境变量。部署前后会自动检查构建是否通过、部署是否成功、URL 是否可访问，确认无误后才通知你。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、发布或托管一个 Web 应用，或者要管理 Vercel 的项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: Claude 会运行部署命令并验证成功

say.text: 列出我的 Vercel 项目
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel project ls

say.text: 添加域名 example.com 到当前项目
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel domains add

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Vercel CLI to deploy web apps to production or preview, manage projects, domains, and environment variables. It runs pre/post checks (local build, deployment status, URL response) and only reports success after verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to deploy, ship, or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains, or environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy the current project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Claude runs deploy command and verifies success

say_en.text: Add domain example.com to current project
